;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**Four [[humvee]]s packed with explosives controlled by [[Suicide attack|suicide bombers]] kill 23, including eight election workers, in the province of [[Kandahar Province|Kandahar]]. The Taliban claimed 57 were killed. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban/fighting-rages-across-afghanistan-as-peace-talks-continue-idUSKCN1TV0AD (Reuters)]
*[[2018–19 Sudanese protests]]
**Ten people are killed in [[Sudan]] during clashes between the [[Sudanese military]] and civilian protesters. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sudan-politics/tens-of-thousands-demand-civilian-rule-in-sudan-at-least-seven-killed-idUSKCN1TV0IY (Reuters)]
*Gunmen open fire, killing two guards and wounding another for Lebanese Refugee Affairs Minister, Saleh al-Gharib. This attack happened in a mountain village near [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/06/gunmen-open-fire-lebanese-minister-convoy-killing-190630164714839.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.dw.com/en/lebanese-officials-shot-dead-in-attack-on-ministers-convoy/a-49422757 (DW)]
*[[Northern Mali conflict]]
**At least 23 people are dead and 300 missing after attacks on three [[Fula people|Fulani]] villages in central [[Mali]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-security/attack-on-mali-fulani-village-kills-23-local-mayor-idUSKCN1TW2YT (Reuters)]
**12 civilians including a baby were killed when the vehicle they were traveling in hit a landmine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/07/attack-fulani-village-central-mali-kills-23-local-mayor-190701183633647.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Disasters and accidents
*Ten people are killed when a [[Beechcraft_Super_King_Air#Super_King_Air_300/350|Beechcraft BE-350 King Air]] crashes into a hangar at [[Addison Airport]] in [[Addison, Texas]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/10-dead-plane-crash-texas-n1025126 (NBC News)]

;International relations
*[[2019 Koreas–United States DMZ Summit]], [[North Korea–United States relations]], [[South Korea–United States relations]], [[North Korea–South Korea relations]], [[2018–19 Korean peace process]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], together with [[President of South Korea|South Korean President]] [[Moon Jae-in]], meets [[List of leaders of North Korea|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] at the [[Joint Security Area]], becoming the first sitting U.S. president to set foot in North Korea. Trump also invites Kim to the [[White House]] to resume talks about denuclearizing the Korean Peninsula. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-kim-jong-un-meet-dmz-n1025041 (NBC News)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/trump-shakes-hands-with-kim-jong-un-and-invites-him-to-the-white-house-2019-6 (''Business Insider'')] [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-dmz-kim-live-intl-hnk/h_7c89c85737f16f7da758bcc1319c8b87 (CNN)]
*Princess [[Haya bint Hussein]] of Jordan fled her husband [[Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum]], the Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, with their two children in fear for her life. The family fled to London via Germany seeking asylum, and a high profile court battle over non-[[repatriation]] and custody of the children is anticipated. [https://www.thetimes.co.uk/article/sheikh-s-wife-flees-to-london-home-wpd8g906p (''Times'')]

;Law and crime
*In the second similar case within a week, police in [[Toyonaka]], [[Japan]], arrest Ryotaro Taniguchi for keeping the body of his deceased mother a year after her death. He is quoted as saying he didn't want to pay for the funeral. Police are investigating whether or not Taniguchi continued to receive his mother's pension. [https://japantoday.com/category/crime/man-arrested-for-keeping-mother%E2%80%99s-body-in-apartment-for-a-year (''Japan Today'')] [https://japantoday.com/category/crime/man-admits-not-reporting-father%E2%80%99s-death-for-months-in-order-to-keep-collecting-pension (''The Japan Times'')]
